tabs.name: 企业简介
tabs.title: 中国银行简介
content: 中国银行是中国持续经营时间最久的银行。1912年2月正式成立，先后行使中央银行、国际汇兑银行和国际贸易专业银行职能。1949年以后，长期作为国家外汇外贸专业银行，统一经营管理国家外汇，开展国际贸易结算、侨汇和其他非贸易外汇业务。1994年改组为国有独资商业银行，全面提供各类金融服务，发展成为本外币兼营、业务品种齐全、实力雄厚的大型商业银行。2006年率先成功在香港联交所和上交所挂牌上市，成为国内首家“A+H”上市银行。中国银行是2008年北京夏季奥运会和2022年北京冬季奥运会唯一官方银行合作伙伴，是中国唯一的“双奥银行”。2011年，中国银行成为新兴经济体中首家全球系统重要性银行，目前已连续15年入选，国际地位、竞争能力、综合实力跻身全球大型银行前列。

中国银行是中国全球化和综合化程度最高的银行。2025年末，本行在中国境内及境外64个国家和地区设有机构，覆盖45个共建“一带一路”国家和地区，在境外19个国家和地区担任指定人民币清算行。中银香港、澳门分行担任当地的发钞行。中国银行始终坚持以客户为中心的发展理念，形成了以公司金融、个人金融和金融市场等商业银行业务为主体，涵盖投资银行、直接投资、证券、保险、基金、飞机租赁、资产管理、金融科技、金融租赁等多个领域的综合金融服务体系，为超840万公司客户和超5.5亿个人客户提供“一点接入、全球响应、综合服务”的金融解决方案。
中国银行是拥有崇高使命感和责任感的银行。本行深刻把握金融工作的政治性、人民性，以服务实体经济为根本宗旨，以防控风险为永恒主题，以巩固扩大全球化优势、提升全球布局能力为首要任务，着力做好科技金融、绿色金融、普惠金融、养老金融、数字金融五篇大文章。深入践行中国特色金融文化，积极支持并开展各类公益慈善活动，主动将担当社会责任和可持续发展融入经营管理与改革发展全过程。

在全面建设社会主义现代化国家的新征程上，中国银行将坚持以习近平新时代中国特色社会主义思想为指导，完整准确全面贯彻新发展理念，找准落实中央决策部署和实现自身高质量发展的结合点、发力点、支撑点，当好贯彻党中央决策部署的实干家、服务实体经济的主力军、服务双循环新发展格局的排头兵、维护金融稳定的压舱石、做优做强国有大型金融机构的行动派，坚定不移走好中国特色金融发展之路，不断开创中国银行高质量发展新局面，为以中国式现代化全面推进强国建设、民族复兴伟业作出更大贡献。

tabs.name: 招聘公告
tabs.title: 中国银行股份有限公司2027年全球校园招聘公告
content: 中国银行于1912年2月正式成立，是中国持续经营时间最久的银行，也是中国全球化和综合化程度最高的银行，在中国境内及境外64个国家和地区设有机构，为客户提供全面的金融服务。
根据业务发展需要，中国银行启动2027年全球校园招聘，相关信息公告如下：
&一、招聘机构
本次招聘采取统一组织的形式，参与招聘的机构包括总行、总行直属机构、审计分部、境内分行、港澳台及海外机构、综合经营公司。
&二、招聘岗位
&（一）总行
1．总行管理培训生
总行部门管理培训生分为信息科技、业务发展、金融市场、风险合规、综合管理、全球化共6个方向。作为总行部门相关业务及管理人才储备，一般安排实践锻炼1年。按照各方向培养计划，先在境内机构及相关业务条线培养锻炼，再统一安排到全球不同国家和地区的境外机构进行实践锻炼。为加强总行全球化人才培养与储备，实践锻炼结束后，全球化方向管培生需在境外机构外派工作1-2年。
上海总部管理培训生岗位，作为金融机构跨境业务、人民币交易业务、跨境清算业务等方向人才储备，一般安排实践锻炼1年，根据培养情况安排在上海总部工作，工作地点为上海。
2．小语种专项计划
小语种专项计划岗位作为中国银行全球化经营的重要人才储备，招聘入行后根据工作需要和培养情况，安排在相应机构工作。根据本人意愿，与中国银行境内分行签订劳动合同及服从外派安排协议（特别优秀的与中国银行总行签订劳动合同及服从外派安排协议）。
招收语种：德语、法语、西班牙语、葡萄牙语、瑞典语、匈牙利语、波兰语、捷克语、塞尔维亚语。
&（二）总行直属机构
1．信用卡中心金融综合、信息科技岗位，面向境内外院校招收应届毕业生。信用卡中心主要负责信用卡业务管理、产品研发、品牌营销、消费者权益保护、风险管理和中后台集中运营等。工作地点为北京。
2．养老金融中心金融综合岗位，面向境内外院校招收应届毕业生。养老金融中心主要负责统筹开展养老金金融、养老服务金融、养老产业金融政策研究和市场分析，年金业务发展与营销管理，养老金融场景生态建设等。工作地点为北京。
3．数字资产运营中心数据分析岗位，面向境内外院校招收应届毕业生。数字资产运营中心主要负责集团数据运营、数据分析、数据应用及前沿技术研究运用，通过数据分析为业务赋能。工作地点为北京。
4．信息科技运营中心信息科技岗位，面向境内外院校招收应届毕业生。信息科技运营中心主要负责全行信息系统生产运营管理、集团网络安全防控及集团云建设、信息科技生产运营领域数字化建设。工作地点为北京、上海、合肥、呼和浩特。
5．软件中心信息科技岗位，面向境内外院校招收应届毕业生。软件中心主要负责全行应用系统开发、测试和维护工作。工作地点为北京、深圳、西安、合肥、上海、武汉、成都。
6．国际结算单证处理中心单证业务综合、信息科技岗位，面向境内外院校招收应届毕业生。单证中心主要负责境内外分行及总行本部单证类国际结算及贸易融资业务、单证尽职调查业务、金融机构尽调业务、全球现金管理业务的后台集中化运营，为前台业务咨询、产品推广、客户营销提供专业技术支持，协助相关业务系统建设。工作地点为北京、上海。
7．集约运营中心集约运营业务、运营科技支持岗位，面向境内外院校招收应届毕业生。集约运营中心主要负责全行标准性业务、综合经营公司及海外机构业务的集中处理、生产管理，推进相关系统建设和流程优化等，为全集团业务发展提供集约共享的智慧运营支撑。工作地点为佛山、武汉。
8．远程银行中心金融综合、线上运营业务岗位，面向境内外院校招收应届毕业生。远程银行中心主要负责95566、4006695566等线上客服渠道建设、运营和管理，并依托金融科技赋能，高效开展线上业务咨询、业务办理等客户服务以及相关运营支持工作。工作地点为北京、昆山、西安、广州。
9．北京高级研修院培训研发岗位，面向境内外院校招收应届毕业生。北京高级研修院主要负责政治能力培训、各层级管理者领导力培训、专业人才培训、“中银研修”云平台建设等工作，同时作为中国银行党校，主要负责开展党校教学、学员管理以及对分行党校的业务指导等工作。工作地点为北京。
10．上海高级研修院培训研发岗位，面向境内外院校招收应届毕业生。上海高级研修院主要负责培训项目开发与实施、教学研发等工作，为人才培养及学科建设提供专业支持，同时作为中国银行党校（上海校区），主要负责开发各类党校课程及党校培训项目实施。工作地点为上海。
&（三）审计分部
审计分部审计员、审计数据分析员岗位，面向境内外院校招收应届毕业生，从事审计数据分析系统管理、审计数据处理、审计业务等工作。
&（四）境内分行
1．管理培训生岗位，面向境内外院校招收应届毕业生，作为分行各级管理机构经营管理和专业技术人才储备，招收入行后在基层一线培养锻炼1年左右，根据培养情况再安排至各级管理机构工作。
2．信息科技岗位，面向境内外院校招收信息科技相关专业应届毕业生，到分行各级机构从事信息科技相关工作。
3．营业网点业务岗位（营销服务），面向境内外院校招收应届毕业生，作为营销服务岗位储备人选，先在综合服务经理等岗位培养锻炼一段时间后，综合考虑工作表现、个人素质等情况，聘任到营业网点或其他经营管理机构相关岗位从事营销服务工作。
4．营业网点业务岗位（综合服务），面向境内外院校招收应届毕业生，从事营业网点柜面业务、厅堂服务等综合服务工作。
&（五）港澳台及海外机构
面向境内外院校招收应届毕业生（含中国内地及港澳台生、外籍留学生），能够满足在相应国家或地区工作的国籍或签证等相关要求。了解并热爱中华文化，有志于推动中外文化交流与合作，愿意从事银行业务或相应岗位工作。
&（六）综合经营公司
面向境内外院校招收应届毕业生，从事金融业务或相应岗位工作。
具体的招聘岗位、应聘条件，请登录中国银行校园招聘网站查询。
&三、报名方式
应聘者自即日起，可登录中国银行校园招聘网站查询相关信息，在线注册并填写个人信息后，选择相应机构的岗位进行在线报名（每人最多可申请5个岗位，其中应聘北京、上海、广东、深圳等境内一级分行或直属分行可申请1-2个岗位，应聘其他一级机构可申请1个岗位；所有岗位均为平行志愿，不分先后）。
报名截止时间为北京时间2026年10月9日24点。
&四、注意事项
（一）请应聘者准确、完整填写简历和相关资料信息，保证信息真实性；如与事实不符，中国银行有权取消其应聘资格。
（二）各机构的招聘岗位、应聘条件存在一定差异，部分机构对应聘者范围有专门要求，请应聘者根据本人情况申报，避免无效申请。
（三）中国银行初步定于10月中下旬组织统一笔试，具体安排将通过电子邮件或95566短信等方式通知本人。
（四）招聘过程中，中国银行将通过应聘者在线报名时填写的联系方式（包括手机、电子邮件等）与本人联系，请确保准确填写并保持通讯畅通。
（五）中国银行未成立或委托成立任何考试中心、命题中心等机构或类似机构，从未编辑或出版过任何校园招聘考试参考资料，从未向任何机构提供过考试相关的资料和信息。在招聘过程中，中国银行不会向应聘者收取任何费用，请提高警惕，谨防受骗。
（六）中国银行有权根据岗位需求变化及报名情况等因素，调整、取消或终止个别岗位的招聘工作，并对本次招聘享有最终解释权。
（七）“中国银行官方网站”“中国银行人才招聘”官方微信公众号、“中国银行校园招聘网站”是我行发布校园招聘公告及相关信息的官方渠道，其他渠道均未获得我行授权或许可。

tabs.name: How to apply
tabs.title: 2027 Bank of China Global Campus Recruitment
content: Established in February 1912, Bank of China Limited (hereinafter referred to as the “Bank” or “BOC”) is the bank with the longest history of continuous operation in China and also the bank with the most globalized operation and the most integrated business platforms in this country. The Bank has institutions in the Chinese mainland and 64 countries and regions overseas, and provides a full suite of financial services to its customers.
To meet its business needs, the Bank now launches its 2027 Global Campus Recruitment. Relevant details are as follows:
&I. Offices or Institutions with Placement Opportunities

Placement opportunities are available in Head Office, institutions affiliated to the Head Office, audit division, domestic branches, branches in Hong Kong (China), Macao (China), Taiwan (China) and other countries and regions, and in comprehensive operation companies.
&II. Job Openings
&A. Head Office
1. Head Office Management Trainee

The Management Trainee Program at the Head Office departments offers six specialized tracks, namely IT, business development, financial markets, risk management and compliance, general management, and globalization. As business and management professionals for relevant departments of the Head Office, management trainees generally undergo one year of practical training. Based on the specific development plan of each track, trainees first receive training and gain experience at domestic institutions and relevant business lines before being assigned to overseas institutions in different countries and regions for further practice. To strengthen the training and reserve of global talent at the Head Office, management trainees in the globalization track will be assigned to work at overseas institutions for one to two years after completing their practical training.

Management Trainee of the Shanghai RMB Trading Unit will join the Bank's talent pool in such business areas like the cross-border business, RMB transaction, and cross-border clearing of financial institutions. They will be first assigned to work for one year for practical training and then transferred to the Shanghai RMB Trading Unit based on work performance. Place of work: Shanghai.
2. Job openings for Graduates of Foreign Languages other than English

Graduates of foreign languages (other than English) will be an important part of the Bank's talent pool supporting its globalized operation. Recruited persons will be assigned to corresponding institutions subject to business needs and their performance. Graduates of foreign languages (other than English) will, of their own choice, sign an employment contract and an expatriate agreement with a domestic branch, while those with exceptional performance will sign the employment contract and expatriate agreement with the Head Office.
Languages needed: German, French, Spanish, Portuguese, Swedish, Hungarian, Polish, Czech, and Serbian.
&B. Institutions affiliated to the Head Office

1. Credit Card Center: comprehensive financial services and IT positions are open to fresh graduates from universities both at home and abroad. The Credit Card Center is mainly responsible for credit card business, including product R&D, brand marketing, consumer protection, risk management and middle-office and back-office management. Place of work: Beijing.

2. Pension Finance Center: comprehensive financial services positions are open to fresh graduates from universities both at home and abroad. The Pension Finance Center is mainly responsible for policy research and market analysis of pension finance, pension service finance and pension finance industry, annuity business development and marketing management, and the ecosystem development of pension finance scenarios. Place of work: Beijing.

3. Digital Asset Operation Center: data analysis positions are open to fresh graduates from universities both at home and abroad. The Digital Asset Operation Center is mainly responsible for the Group's data operation, data analysis, data application and the research and application of cutting-edge technologies, empowering business through data analysis. Place of work: Beijing.

4. IT Operation Center: IT positions are open to fresh graduates from universities both at home and abroad. The IT Operation Center is mainly responsible for production and operation management of information systems across the Bank, Group cybersecurity and Group cloud-platform building, and digitalization in IT production and operation. Place of work: Beijing, Shanghai, Hefei or Hohhot.

5. Software Center: IT positions are open to fresh graduates from universities both at home and abroad. The Software Center is mainly responsible for the development, testing and maintenance of information systems across the Bank. Place of work: Beijing, Shenzhen, Xi'an, Hefei, Shanghai, Wuhan or Chengdu.

6. International Settlement Center: documentation operations generalist positions and IT positions are open to fresh graduates from universities both at home and abroad. The International Settlement Center is mainly responsible for the centralized back-office operations of documentary international settlement and trade finance business, documentary due diligence business, financial institution due diligence business, and global cash management business for domestic branches, overseas branches and the Head Office, providing professional support to front-office business including consulting, product marketing and customer expansion. Place of work: Beijing or Shanghai.

7. Intensive Operation Center: intensive operation positions and operational technology support positions are open to fresh graduates from universities both at home and abroad. The Intensive Operation Center is mainly responsible for the intensive processing and production management of the standard business across the Bank and the business of comprehensive operation companies and overseas institutions, promoting the building of relevant systems and process optimization, and providing centralized, shared, intelligent operational support for business development throughout the Group. Place of work: Foshan or Wuhan.

8. Air Bank Center: comprehensive financial services and online business operation positions are open to fresh graduates from universities both at home and abroad. The Air Bank Center is mainly responsible for the development, operation and management of online customer service channels such as 95566 and 4006695566. Empowered by FinTech, it efficiently provides online customer services such as business consulting and business processing, as well as relevant operation support. Place of work: Beijing, Kunshan, Xi'an or Guangzhou.

9. BOC Beijing Advanced Academy: training R&D positions are open to fresh graduates from universities both at home and abroad. The Academy is mainly responsible for political capacity training, leadership development programs for managers at all levels, professional talent training, and the building of the BOC Academy cloud platform. Place of work: Beijing.

10. BOC Shanghai Advanced Academy: training R&D positions are open to fresh graduates from universities both at home and abroad. The Academy is mainly responsible for the development and implementation of training programs, teaching research and development, and other related work, providing professional support for talent development and discipline building. Place of work: Shanghai.
&C. Audit Division

Auditor and audit data analyst positions are open to fresh graduates from universities both at home and abroad. Recruits will be assigned to tasks such as managing data analysis systems, processing audit data, or conducting audits.
&D. Domestic branches

1. Management Trainee positions: open to fresh graduates from universities both at home and abroad. As a talent reserve for management and professional technical roles at various levels within the branch's administrative framework, recruits will undergo approximately one year of frontline training and development before being assigned to work in management institutions at various levels within the branch.
2. IT positions: open to fresh graduates from universities both at home and abroad. Recruits will be involved in IT-related work at different levels of branches.

3. Positions at outlets (marketing services): open to fresh graduates from universities both at home and abroad. As a reserve for marketing service roles, recruits will first work in positions like comprehensive service manager for a period of time for practical training, and then be assigned to provide marketing services in relevant positions at outlets or other business management institutions based on their performances, personal aptitudes, etc.

4. Positions at outlets (comprehensive services): open to fresh graduates from universities both at home and abroad. Recruits will be assigned to provide comprehensive services such as counter service and lobby service at outlets.
&E. Branches in Hong Kong (China), Macao (China), Taiwan (China) and other countries and regions

Positions are open to fresh graduates from universities both at home and abroad, including students from Mainland China, Hong Kong (China), Macao (China), Taiwan (China), and international students. Candidates must meet the applicable nationality or visa requirements for working in the relevant country or region. Applicants should have a good understanding of and passion for Chinese culture, be committed to promoting cultural exchange and cooperation between China and other countries, and be willing to engage in banking or related roles.
&F. Comprehensive operation companies
Positions in financial services related areas are open to fresh graduates from universities both at home and abroad.
For specific positions and job requirements, please go to the Campus Recruitment page on the website of the Bank.
&III. How to Apply

Recruitment information is available on the Campus Recruitment page on the website of Bank of China as from today. After registering online and filling in personal information, applicants may choose positions at corresponding institutions and start applying (Each applicant may apply for no more than five positions. Applicants applying to domestic tier-1 branches in Beijing, Shanghai, Guangdong, Shenzhen and other locations may apply for one to two positions, while applicants applying to other tier-1 institutions may apply for one position. All positions are parallel and are listed in no particular order).
The application deadline is 24:00 on October 9, 2026 Beijing Time.
&IV. Reminders
1. Please fill in accurate, complete and authentic information during application, otherwise, the applicant will be disqualified by the Bank.
2. As positions and job requirements vary, please read very carefully and make sure that your skills, knowledge and experience match the job positions that you apply.
3. Written examinations are expected to be held in mid-to-late October. Details will be sent to you via email or a SMS message from 95566.

4. Throughout the recruitment process, the Bank will contact you using the information (including cellphone number and email address) that you filled in when applying online. Please make sure your contact information is correct and that you can be reached.

5. The Bank does not have any test center, exam-setting center or any similar institutions established by itself or by others at its request. The Bank has never compiled or published any reference materials for the campus recruitment examination or provided examination-related materials or information to any institution. During recruitment, the Bank will not collect any fee from applicants. Please stay vigilant and beware of fraud.

6. The Bank reserves the right to adjust, cancel, or terminate the recruitment for individual positions based on changes in job requirements, application volumes, and other relevant factors. The final interpretation of the recruitment is at the sole discretion of the Bank.

7. The official website of BOC, the official WeChat account "Bank of China Talent Recruitment" (中国银行人才招聘) and the website "Bank of China Global Campus Recruitment" (中国银行全球校园招聘) are the official channels for publishing campus recruitment announcements and related information. Other channels are not authorized or permitted.

tabs.name: 招聘条件
tabs.title: 中国银行股份有限公司2027年全球校园招聘条件
content: &一、基本条件
（一）遵纪守法、诚实守信，具有良好的个人品质和职业道德，无不良记录，愿意履行中国银行员工义务和岗位职责。
（二）具有与岗位要求相适应的专业、学历及能力素质。
（三）具有较好的团队合作精神、语言沟通能力和学习能力。
（四）具有正常履行工作职责的身体条件和心理素质。
（五）符合中国银行亲属回避的有关规定。
（六）岗位要求具备的其他条件。
&二、岗位条件
（一）总行部门岗位
1．境内外院校应届毕业生。
2．大学本科及以上学历，其中：
管理培训生（信息科技）岗位主要招收计算机科学与技术、信息与通信工程、网络安全、软件工程、管理科学与工程、数学、系统科学及大数据、人工智能等相关专业毕业生；
管理培训生（业务发展）岗位主要招收理学、工学、经济学、管理学、法学等相关专业毕业生；
管理培训生（金融市场）岗位主要招收数学、计算机科学与技术、软件工程、理学、工学、经济学、管理学、法学专业毕业生；
管理培训生（风险合规）岗位主要招收法学、理学、工学、经济学、管理学等相关专业毕业生；
管理培训生（综合管理）岗位主要招收理学、工学、经济学、管理学、文学、法学等相关专业毕业生，中共党员优先；
管理培训生（全球化）岗位主要招收理学、工学、经济学、管理学、法学、国际贸易、世界经济、国际商务、国际法、国际政治等相关专业毕业生；
上海总部管理培训生岗位主要招收理学、工学、经济学、管理学、法学等相关专业毕业生。
3．具有优秀的综合素质、学习能力和创新能力，有良好的协作精神和发展潜力。
4．具有良好的英语听说读写能力，国家大学英语六级考试（CET-6）425分及以上，或提供具备相应英语能力的资格证明（如TOEIC听读公开考试715分及以上、TOEFL iBT 85分及以上、IELTS 6.5分及以上）。
（二）小语种专项计划
1．境内外院校应届毕业生。
2．大学本科及以上学历。
3．小语种专项计划岗位主要招收德语、法语、西班牙语、葡萄牙语、瑞典语、匈牙利语、波兰语、捷克语、塞尔维亚语专业毕业生，具有良好的听说读写能力，能熟练运用上述语言开展工作。
4．具有优秀的综合素质、学习能力和创新能力，有良好的协作精神和发展潜力。
（三）总行直属机构
1．境内外院校应届毕业生。
2．大学本科及以上学历。
信用卡中心主要招收经济学、法学、理学、工学、管理学等相关专业毕业生；
养老金融中心主要招收经济学、法学、管理学、理学、工学等相关专业毕业生；
数字资产运营中心主要招收经济学、管理学、理学、工学、法学等相关专业毕业生；
信息科技运营中心主要招收计算机、通信、网络空间安全、信息安全、电子信息、数学、人工智能、电气工程、能源动力等相关专业毕业生；
软件中心主要招收计算机、信息安全、人工智能、信息与通信工程、自动化、数学等相关专业毕业生；
国际结算单证处理中心主要招收计算机、人工智能、数学、西班牙语、法语、葡萄牙语、德语、俄语、经济学、管理学、法学等相关专业毕业生；
集约运营中心主要招收理学、工学、经济学、管理学、法学、文学等相关专业毕业生；
远程银行中心主要招收理学、工学、经济学、法学、管理学、文学等相关专业毕业生；
北京高级研修院主要招收教育学、经济学、管理学、理学、法学等相关专业毕业生；
上海高级研修院主要招收经济学、管理学、理学、工学、法学等相关专业毕业生。
3．具有较好的基本素质、专业基础和协作精神，有较强的责任感和良好的学习能力。
4．具有较好的英语听说读写能力，国家大学英语四级考试（CET-4）425分及以上，或提供具备相应英语能力的资格证明（如TOEIC听读公开考试630分及以上、TOEFL iBT 70分及以上、IELTS 5.5分及以上）；主修语种为其他外语，通过相应外语水平考试的，可适当放宽上述英语等级要求。
（四）审计分部岗位
1．境内外院校应届毕业生。
2．大学本科及以上学历，主要招收数学、统计、信息管理、计算机、金融工程、审计、经济、金融等相关专业毕业生。
3．具有较好的基本素质、专业基础和协作精神，有较强的责任感和良好的学习能力。
4．具有较好的英语听说读写能力，国家大学英语四级考试（CET-4）425分及以上，或提供具备相应英语能力的资格证明（如TOEIC听读公开考试630分及以上、TOEFL iBT 70分及以上、IELTS 5.5分及以上）；主修语种为其他外语，通过相应外语水平考试的，可适当放宽上述英语等级要求。
（五）境内分行管理培训生岗位
1．境内外院校应届毕业生。
2．大学本科及以上学历，主要招收理学、工学、经济学、管理学、法学等相关专业毕业生。
3．具有较好的综合素质、学习能力和创新能力，有良好的协作精神和发展潜力。
4．具有较好的英语听说读写能力，国家大学英语六级考试（CET-6）425分及以上，或提供具备相应英语能力的资格证明（如TOEIC听读公开考试715分及以上、TOEFL iBT 85分及以上、IELTS 6.5分及以上）；主修语种为其他外语，通过相应外语水平考试的，可适当放宽上述英语等级要求。
（六）境内分行信息科技岗位
1．境内外院校应届毕业生。
2．大学本科及以上学历，主要招收信息科技等相关专业毕业生。
3．具有较好的基本素质、专业基础和协作精神，有较强的责任感和良好的学习能力。
4．具有较好的英语听说读写能力，国家大学英语四级考试（CET-4）425分及以上，或提供具备相应英语能力的资格证明（如TOEIC听读公开考试630分及以上、TOEFL iBT 70分及以上、IELTS 5.5分及以上）；主修语种为其他外语，通过相应外语水平考试的，可适当放宽上述英语等级要求。
（七）境内分行营业网点业务岗位（营销服务）
1．境内外院校应届毕业生。
2．大学本科及以上学历，主要招收理学、工学、经济学、管理学、法学、文学等相关专业毕业生。
3．具有较好的基本素质、服务观念和协作精神，有较强的责任感和良好的学习能力。
4．具有较好的英语听说读写能力，国家大学英语四级考试（CET-4）425分及以上，或提供具备相应英语能力的资格证明（如TOEIC听读公开考试630分及以上、TOEFL iBT 70分及以上、IELTS 5.5分及以上）；主修语种为其他外语，通过相应外语水平考试的，可适当放宽上述英语等级要求。
（八）境内分行营业网点业务岗位（综合服务）
1．境内外院校应届毕业生。
2．大学本科及以上学历，主要招收理学、工学、经济学、管理学、法学、文学等相关专业毕业生。部分生源欠佳地区机构（主要为县域机构）可为专升本，对于位于国家乡村振兴重点帮扶县的，学历可为大专，要求家庭或生活基础在招聘岗位所在城市。
3．具有较好的基本素质、服务观念和协作精神，有较强的责任感和良好的学习能力。
4．一般应具有较好的英语听说读写能力。
（九）港澳台及海外机构、综合经营公司相关岗位见各岗位具体的资格条件。
&三、相关说明
（一）各机构在上述基本条件、岗位条件的基础上，将分别明确具体的招聘条件，请应聘者根据本人情况申报，避免无效申请。
（二）应聘者应满足以下毕业时间要求：
1．境内院校应届毕业生，应在2026年1月1日至2027年7月31日期间毕业且为毕业后初次就业，并获得毕业证、学位证原件及相关资格证书，可开始全职工作。
2．境外院校应届毕业生，应为2026年1月1日至2027年7月31日期间毕业且为毕业后初次就业，并能够在2027年7月31日前获得学历（学位）证书原件，可开始全职工作。入职前应取得国家教育部留学服务中心出具的学历学位认证。
（三）中外合作联合办学项目毕业生，应符合上述要求之一。
（四）以上所提及“应届毕业生”，均为境内外普通高等院校毕业生，不含定向生、委培生。

tabs.name: What we look for
tabs.title: Qualifications Required for 2027 Bank of China Global Campus Recruitment
content: &I. Basic Requirements

1. Candidates should comply with laws and orders, demonstrate integrity and strong work ethics, have no record of misconduct, and be willing to fulfill the obligations and responsibilities as employees of Bank of China.
2. Candidates should meet the job requirements in terms of education, expertise, and competencies.
3. Candidates should have good team spirit, communication skills and learning capabilities.
4. Candidates should be physically and mentally capable to perform duties.
5. Candidates should comply with the Bank's anti-nepotism policies.
6. Candidates should also meet other requirements necessary for the position.
&II. Job Requirements
&A. Positions at the Head Office departments
1. Candidates should be fresh graduates from universities both at home and abroad.
2. Candidates should obtain a Bachelor's degree or above in the following majors:

Management Trainee (IT): Computer Science and Technology, Information and Communication Engineering, Cybersecurity, Software Engineering, Management Science and Engineering, Mathematics, Systems Science and Big Data, Artificial Intelligence or other related fields;
Management Trainee (Business Development): Science, Engineering, Economics, Management, Law or other related fields;
Management Trainee (Financial Markets): Mathematics, Computer Science and Technology, Software Engineering, Science, Engineering, Economics, Management, Law or other related fields;
Management Trainee (Risk Management and Compliance): Law, Science, Engineering, Economics, Management or other related fields;
Management Trainee (General Management): Science, Engineering, Economics, Management, Literature, Law or other related fields;

Management Trainee (Globalization): Science, Engineering, Economics, Management, Law, International Trade, World Economy, International Business, International Law, International Politics or other related fields;
Management Trainee at Shanghai RMB Trading Unit: Science, Engineering, Economics, Management, Law or other related fields.
3. Candidates should possess comprehensive personal qualities, strong learning agility, and a capacity for innovation, coupled with effective collaboration skills and strong development potential.

4. Candidates should have good command of English listening, speaking, reading and writing, with CET-6 score of 425 or above, or other qualifications to indicate English proficiency (e.g. TOEIC Listening & Reading score of 715 or above, TOEFL iBT score of 85 or above, or IELTS score of 6.5 or above).
&B. Positions for graduates of foreign languages other than English
1. Candidates should be fresh graduates from universities both at home and abroad.
2. Candidates should obtain a Bachelor's degree or above.

3. We look for candidates majoring in German, French, Spanish, Portuguese, Swedish, Hungarian, Polish, Czech, and Serbian. Candidates should have good command of listening, speaking, reading and writing, and be proficient enough to work in one of these languages.
4. Candidates should possess comprehensive personal qualities, strong learning agility, and a capacity for innovation, coupled with effective collaboration skills and strong development potential.
&C. Positions at institutions affiliated to the Head Office
1. Candidates should be fresh graduates from universities both at home and abroad.
2. Candidates should obtain a Bachelor's degree or above in the following majors:
Credit Card Center: Economics, Law, Science, Engineering, Management or other related fields;
Pension Finance Center: Economics, Law, Management, Science, Engineering or other related fields;
Digital Asset Operation Center: Economics, Management, Science, Engineering, Law or other related fields;

IT Operation Center: Computer Science, Communications, Cyberspace Security, Information Security, Electronic Information, Mathematics, Artificial Intelligence, Electrical Engineering, Energy and Power Engineering or other related fields;
Software Center: Computer Science, Information Security, Artificial Intelligence, Information and Communication Engineering, Automation, Mathematics or other related fields;
International Settlement Center: Computer Science, Artificial Intelligence, Mathematics, Spanish, French, Portuguese, German, Russian, Economics, Management, Law or other related fields;
Intensive Operation Center: Science, Engineering, Economics, Management, Law, Literature or other related fields;
Air Bank Center: Science, Engineering, Economics, Law, Management, Literature or other related fields;
BOC Beijing Advanced Academy: Education, Economics, Management, Science, Law or other related fields;
BOC Shanghai Advanced Academy: Economics, Management, Science, Engineering, Law or other related fields.
3. Candidates should demonstrate solid fundamental qualities, a strong professional foundation, and a collaborative spirit, along with a strong sense of responsibility and excellent learning ability.

4. Candidates should have good command of English listening, speaking, reading and writing, with CET-4 score of 425 or above, or other qualifications to indicate English proficiency (e.g. TOEIC Listening & Reading score of 630 or above, TOEFL iBT score of 70 or above, or IELTS score of 5.5 or above). These requirements may not strictly apply to candidates who study other foreign languages and pass relevant language tests.
&D. Positions at audit division
1. Candidates should be fresh graduates from universities both at home and abroad.

2. Candidates should obtain a Bachelor's degree or above in Mathematics, Statistics, Information Management, Computer Science, Financial Engineering, Auditing, Economics, Finance or other related fields.
3. Candidates should demonstrate solid fundamental qualities, a strong professional foundation, and a collaborative spirit, along with a strong sense of responsibility and excellent learning ability.

4. Candidates should have good command of English listening, speaking, reading and writing, with CET-4 score of 425 or above, or other qualifications to indicate English proficiency (e.g. TOEIC Listening & Reading score of 630 or above, TOEFL iBT score of 70 or above, or IELTS score of 5.5 or above). These requirements may not strictly apply to candidates who study other foreign languages and pass relevant language tests.
&E. Management trainee positions at domestic branches
1. Candidates should be fresh graduates from universities both at home and abroad.
2. Candidates should obtain a Bachelor's degree or above in Science, Engineering, Economics, Management, Law or other related fields.
3. Candidates should possess comprehensive personal qualities, strong learning agility, and a capacity for innovation, coupled with effective collaboration skills and strong development potential.

4. Candidates should have good command of English listening, speaking, reading and writing, with CET-6 score of 425 or above, or other qualifications to indicate English proficiency (e.g. TOEIC Listening & Reading score of 715 or above, TOEFL iBT score of 85 or above, or IELTS score of 6.5 or above). These requirements may not strictly apply to candidates who study other foreign languages and pass relevant language tests.
&F. IT positions at domestic branches
1. Candidates should be fresh graduates from universities both at home and abroad.
2. Candidates should obtain a Bachelor's degree or above in fields related to information technology.
3. Candidates should demonstrate solid fundamental qualities, a strong professional foundation, and a collaborative spirit, along with a strong sense of responsibility and excellent learning ability.

4. Candidates should have good command of English listening, speaking, reading and writing, with CET-4 score of 425 or above, or other qualifications to indicate English proficiency (e.g. TOEIC Listening & Reading score of 630 or above, TOEFL iBT score of 70 or above, or IELTS score of 5.5 or above). These requirements may not strictly apply to candidates who study other foreign languages and pass relevant language tests.
&G. Positions at domestic outlets (marketing services)
1. Candidates should be fresh graduates from universities both at home and abroad.
2. Candidates should obtain a Bachelor's degree or above in Science, Engineering, Economics, Management, Law, Literature or other related fields.
3. Candidates should demonstrate solid fundamental qualities, a strong service orientation, and a collaborative spirit, along with a strong sense of responsibility and good learning ability.

4. Candidates should have good command of English listening, speaking, reading and writing, with CET-4 score of 425 or above, or other qualifications to indicate English proficiency (e.g. TOEIC Listening & Reading score of 630 or above, TOEFL iBT score of 70 or above, or IELTS score of 5.5 or above). These requirements may not strictly apply to candidates who study other foreign languages and pass relevant language tests.
&H. Positions at domestic outlets (comprehensive services)
1. Candidates should be fresh graduates from universities both at home and abroad.

2. Candidates should obtain a Bachelor's degree or above in Science, Engineering, Economics, Management, Law, Literature or other related fields. Positions at institutions with an undersupply of fresh graduates (primarily county-level institutions) are also available to applicants who obtain a Bachelor's degree through a degree upgrading program from a junior college degree to a Bachelor's degree. Positions in the key counties under the country's rural revitalization program are open to local candidates with a junior college degree.
3. Candidates should demonstrate solid fundamental qualities, a strong service orientation, and a collaborative spirit, along with a strong sense of responsibility and good learning ability.
4. Candidates are preferred to have good command of English listening, speaking, reading and writing.

&I. Job descriptions for positions at branches in Hong Kong (China), Macao (China), Taiwan (China) and other countries and regions, or at comprehensive operation companies, can be found separately on the specific recruitment requirements for each position.
&III. Reminders

A. Institutions with job openings will specify requirements for different positions in addition to the basic requirements and job descriptions mentioned above. Candidates are advised to apply according to their skills and experiences to avoid invalid application.
B. Detailed requirements on time of graduation are as follows:

1. Fresh graduates from domestic universities should graduate between January 1, 2026, and July 31, 2027, having no full-time employment history after graduation, who can obtain the originals of graduation certificate, the degree certificate and relevant qualification certificates before starting to work full time at the Bank.

2. Fresh graduates from overseas universities should graduate between January 1, 2026, and July 31, 2027, having no full-time employment history after graduation, who can obtain the original of graduation (degree) certificate before July 31, 2027 and before starting to work full time at the Bank. They should obtain the accreditation by Chinese Service Center for Scholarly Exchange (CSCSE) of the Ministry of Education before starting to work full time at the Bank.
C. Fresh graduates from joint education programs should meet one of the requirements above.

D. The "fresh graduates" said above refers to graduates from domestic or overseas institutions of higher education, excluding those who are pre-assigned to specific posts or areas, or sent to study by relevant institutions.

springjobs.name: 春季招聘
content: *第一步：在左侧机构列表中，请选择您要应聘的一个分支机构；
*第二步：在您阅读完该机构简介及职位描述后，点击页面下方的“申请该职位”按钮。
$每人最多可申请4个岗位，同一家一级机构仅能申请1个岗位，所有岗位均为平行志愿，不分先后。
*“一级机构”是信息科技运营中心等5家总行直属机构；北京市分行等26家境内一级分行及直属分行；中银香港、迪拜分行、卡塔尔金融中心分行；中银基金等8家综合经营公司。
$春季招聘岗位与实习生招聘岗位不可同时申请。
$完成网申报名后，系统将为您分配一个6位简历编号，该编号将作为您后续招聘环节重要身份依据，请您务必牢记。简历编号信息可通过查阅网申填报邮箱或“英才校园招聘”公众号通知信等途径查找。
*邮箱：service@chinahr.com 邮件主题请标注“中国银行2026年春季招聘-手机号（与简历填写一致）-姓名-申请事由”（此邮箱不接收简历，仅限网申答疑）
